name: Joseph Malula
contribution: A Congolese Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Kinshasa from 1964 until his death.
legacy: He was the first cardinal from Zaire.

checks.lead: Joseph-Albert Malula (12 December 1917 – 14 June 1989) was a Congolese Catholic prelate who served as Archbishop of Kinshasa from 1964 until his death. He was elevated to the cardinalate in 1969.
